sn45.34:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Aṭṭhime bhikkhave dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā apārāpāraṅgamanāya saṃvattanti || || Katame aṭṭha || || Seyyathīdaṃ || sammādiṭṭhi || la || sammāsamādhi || || Ime kho bhikkhave aṭṭha dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā apārāpāraṃ gamanāya saṃvattantī ti || ||
sn45.34:2.1: Idam avoca Bhagavā || idaṃ vatvā Sugato athāparaṃ etad avoca satthā || ||
sn45.34:3.1: Appakā te manussesu || ye janā pāragāmino || athāyam itarā pajā || tīram evānudhāvati || || ()
sn45.34:4.1: Ye ca kho sammadakkhāte || dhamme dhammānuvattino || te janā pāram essanti || maccudheyyaṃ suduttaraṃ || ||
sn45.34:5.1: Kaṇhaṃ dhammam vippahāya || kaṇham bhāvetha paṇḍito || Okā anokam āgamma || viveke yattha dūramam || ||
sn45.34:6.1: Tatrābhiratiṃ iccheyya || hitvā kāme akiñcano || pariyodapeyya attānaṃ || {cittakilesehi}10 paṇḍito || ||
sn45.34:7.1: Yesaṃ sambodhiyaṅgesu || sammācittaṃ subhāvitaṃ || ādānapaṭinissagge || anupādāya ye ratā || || Khīṇāsavā jutimanto || te loke parinibbutā ti || () || 1.2.
